description_en: Deletes a static username and password
name: DeleteAccount

parameters.description_en:
The timestamp that indicates when the static username and password were created. Unit: milliseconds.

Call the [ListAccounts](~~472730~~) operation to find this value.

待删除的静态用户名密码的创建时间戳。单位：毫秒。

您可以调用[ListAccounts](~~472730~~)接口查看。
